note: French Guiana keeps the overseas departments' list; Ecuadorians also stay 90 days in 180 without a visa, Brazilians only 30 days in 180 (until 31 January 2027), and Dominicans and Saint Lucians 15 days a stay (no more than 120 in 12 months, not modelled). Légifrance answers this client with a bot challenge, so the orders are read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of Overseas France
sources.said: For French Guiana, Guadeloupe and Martinique: Ecuador ... For French Guiana, visa exemption for stays of up to 30 days in a 180-day period, until 31 January 2027; ... For French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint Barthélemy, and Saint Martin, visa-free up to 15 days per stay, as long as the stays do not total more than 120 days in a 12-month period.
